description: This file contains Python code for managing and processing test workflow data, including functions to retrieve job and build names from GitHub Actions, extract test exclusions from JSON reports, list workflow run attempts, and upload additional workflow info to S3.

methods.name: get_job_name
methods.description: Retrieves the job name from GitHub API given a job ID, with caching.

methods.name: get_build_name
methods.description: Extracts the build name from a job name string using regex, with caching.

methods.name: get_test_config
methods.description: Extracts the test configuration from a job name string using regex, with caching.

methods.name: get_td_exclusions
methods.description: Downloads, unzips, and processes test exclusion JSON reports to group excluded tests by build and test config.

methods.name: get_all_run_attempts
methods.description: Lists all run attempts for a given workflow run ID that have test artifacts.

methods.name: upload_additional_info
methods.description: Uploads test exclusion data for a specific workflow run and attempt to S3.
